(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A proofed frozen dough comprising: (a) a dough mixture of flour, water, and optionally additives, the dough mixture defining a dough matrix; (b) gas bubbles dispersed throughout the dough matrix; (c) a spent yeast component; and (d) a preserved yeast component, wherein the preserved yeast component includes encapsulated yeast.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 1 to about 8 wt.% of the spent yeast component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the proofed frozen dough comprises about 0.1 to about 2 wt.% of the preserved yeast component.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the preserved yeast component comprises encapsulated yeast, fat-coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The proofed frozen dough of claim 1, wherein the gas bubbles comprise gas produced by the spent yeast component during proofing, thereby enhancing the leavening process. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: A method for making a frozen dough product, the method comprising: (a) mixing dough ingredients to produce a dough composition, the dough ingredients comprising: i. water; ii. flour; iii. a first yeast; and iv. a second yeast; (b) proofing the dough, wherein during proofing the first yeast is spent and the second yeast is preserved, wherein the second yeast includes encapsulated yeast; and (c) freezing the dough after proofing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 19: The method of claim 13, wherein the second yeast comprises encapsulated yeast, fat coated yeast, non-hydrated active dry yeast, non-hydrated instant yeast, non-hydrated semi-dry yeast, non-hydrated frozen yeast, or a combination thereof, to ensure viability during freezing.

(Currently Amended) Claim 25: A method for making a leavened bakery product, the method comprising: (a) mixing dough ingredients to produce a dough, the dough ingredients comprising: i. water; ii. flour; iii. a first yeast; and iv. a second yeast; (b) proofing the dough to produce a proofed dough, wherein the first yeast is spent during the proofing and the second yeast is preserved during the proofing, wherein the second yeast includes encapsulated yeast; (c) freezing the proofed dough; and (d) baking the dough to produce the leavened bakery product.
